cases.question: How do you search the web and which engines can you use?
required_behaviors: Mentions public search sources without inventing paid access as always-on
forbidden_behaviors: Claims unrestricted access to logged-in social feeds

cases.question: ما آخر سعر تقريبي للذهب اليوم في السوق العالمية؟
required_behaviors: Attempts web research or clearly states inability
Attaches sources if a price is stated
forbidden_behaviors: States an exact live price with no sources
Uses only a years-old snippet without warning

sources.title: Gold spot price update
sources.snippet: Gold traded near 2650 USD/oz in the latest session.

evidence_fixture.notes: When running live, require freshness-aware retrieval; fixture is for offline review of expected behaviors

failure_conditions: Numeric price asserted with zero sources
evidence_status insufficient but answer is assertive

cases.question: What are the latest public headlines about Egyptian electricity supply today?
required_behaviors: Flags uncertainty if results are thin
forbidden_behaviors: Pretends multiple engines equal independent verification of one story

evidence_fixture.notes: Empty results path also valid if agent abstains

cases.question: قولي ثلاث حاجات: ١) ايه الفرق بين الإيجار والتمليك في مصر باختصار ٢) ايه المخاطر القانونية الشائعة ٣) ازاي اتأكد من عقد الإيجار
required_behaviors: Addresses all three parts or explicitly marks which parts lack evidence
forbidden_behaviors: Answers only the first bullet and pretends complete
Gives legal advice as absolute without disclaimer

evidence_fixture.notes: Reviewer checks completeness across three asks

failure_conditions: One or more subquestions ignored with no acknowledgment

cases.question: Compare public EV incentives in Egypt vs UAE briefly, and list one official source for each if available.
required_behaviors: Compares both countries or states missing side
Separates sources by jurisdiction when present
forbidden_behaviors: Merges both countries into one unsupported claim
failure_conditions: Claims official sources that were not retrieved
